summary: Iteration 8 — Backend 5/5 PASS against LIVE https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host: GET /api/dashboard/overview (auth) returns 200 with all_contracts=[] + total_contracts=0 for the shared test account; unauth returns 401/403. GET /api/onboarding/badtoken returns 404 (PUBLIC — no 401), confirmed for two different bogus tokens. Login regression 200 OK returning {token,user}. Frontend E2E on https://wide-doc-signing.preview.emergentagent.com @ 390x844: (1) Contracts Overview — /contracts loads after login, renders contracts-header + contracts-empty with 'Scan a bill' CTA; /dashboard/overview called 6× during flow. (2) Entry points — profile-contracts-link on Profile navigates to /contracts and renders the empty overview correctly. dashboard-see-contracts link is only rendered inside the non-empty branch of dashboard.tsx (line 287, gated by !isEmpty), so it is NOT reachable for the empty-state test account by design — matches spec ('not testable without data'). (3) Biometric toggle — Profile shows toggle-biometric switch OFF; tapping it triggers hasHardware/isEnrolled false on web-preview, an info toast reading 'No Face ID / fingerprint is set up on this device.' is shown, switch STAYS OFF, no crash; storage flag uch_biometric_enabled remains unset. (4) Welcome Back — /welcome-back mounts without crash. While signed OUT it auto-proceeds (Platform.OS==='web' branch calls proceed()) → markUnlocked+push /dashboard → auth guard redirects to /signin. While signed IN it auto-proceeds directly to /dashboard (verified redirected_to_dashboard=true). welcome-signout button wired to signOut()+router.replace('/signin'). (5) /biometric/unlock — biometric-title renders, and status resolves to 'ok' on web so biometric-continue button appears; no crash. (6) Onboarding — /onboarding/badtoken (PUBLIC, signed OUT) fetches GET /api/onboarding/badtoken → 404 and renders onboarding-error card with 'This invitation link is invalid or has expired.' message. CRITICAL precedence check PASSED: /onboarding/push-primer resolves to push-primer-title and does NOT render onboarding-error (static route wins over dynamic [token]). (7) Regression — shared login → dashboard-greeting; signout → /signin. Networking: 0/26 /api leaks (100% of calls hit https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host).

action_items: No fixes required for iteration 8 scope. dashboard-see-contracts entry point is only rendered when totalContracts>0 — this matches the review request note 'not testable without data' and is intentional per dashboard.tsx:287.
critical_code_review_comments: contracts/index.tsx: correctly falls back res.all_contracts || res.contracts || [] and gracefully handles ApiError; empty branch renders EmptyState + Scan-a-bill CTA; refresh + focus reload wired via useFocusEffect. Uses colors.urgency map safely.

welcome-back.tsx: Platform.OS==='web' short-circuits to proceed() before touching LocalAuthentication — safe on web-preview. useEffect(() => { unlock() }) runs once on mount. markUnlocked() + router.replace('/dashboard') is the correct handoff pattern. welcome-signout awaits signOut() before router.replace('/signin').
biometric/[mode].tsx: Same web guard pattern; status starts 'idle' and resolves to 'ok' on web so biometric-continue is shown. router.canGoBack() fallback to /dashboard is defensive.

onboarding/[token].tsx: apiRequest called with {auth:false} — no Bearer token on public route; error branch catches ApiError; upload uses FormData (correct for RN/web). Existence of static /onboarding/push-primer.tsx alongside /onboarding/[token].tsx correctly gives Expo Router static-route precedence.

profile.tsx toggleBiometric: guards on hasHardwareAsync && isEnrolledAsync; when false, shows info toast and returns WITHOUT flipping state or writing storage — matches spec. When true, sets state AND persists via storage.setItem.
auth-context.tsx: added `unlocked` + `markUnlocked` state (default false, set true on welcome-back proceed); index.tsx correctly gates on flags.biometric && !unlocked → /welcome-back.
Networking: 0/26 /api calls leaked to preview host; all resolved to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host).
